question: The value of 30 + 180 ÷ 30 × 6 − 15 − 16 − 60 ÷ 3 − 15 is:
solution:
**Given:** 

**Expression**: 30 + 180 ÷ 30 × 6 - 15 - 16 - 60 ÷ 3 - 15

**Formula Used:**

Order of Operations (PEMDAS/BODMAS): Parentheses, Exponents (i.e., powers and square roots, etc.), Multiplication and Division (left-to-right), Addition and Subtraction (left-to-right).

**Calculation:**

Step-by-step solution:

First, perform the divisions and multiplications:

⇒ 30 + (180 ÷ 30) × 6 - 15 - 16 - (60 ÷ 3) - 15

⇒ 30 + 6 × 6 - 15 - 16 - 20 - 15

⇒ 30 + 36 - 15 - 16 - 20 - 15

Next, perform the additions and subtractions in sequence:

⇒ 66 - 15 - 16 - 20 - 15

⇒ 51 - 16 - 20 - 15

⇒ 35 - 20 - 15

⇒ 15 - 15

⇒ 0

**The value of the expression is 0.**
